pages.title: Angebote & Rechnungen
pages.purpose: List quotes, invoices and cancellations; filter by kind and status (incl. overdue); create a new invoice or quote.

urlState.meaning: invoice | quote | cancellation (chip nav; none = Alle)
draft | sent | overdue | paid | accepted | cancelled (FilterMenu; overdue = sent invoices past due date)

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.notes: all-label 'Alle Status'; options Entwurf, Offen, Überfällig, Bezahlt, Angenommen, Storniert (no 'Abgelehnt')

pages.empty: 'Noch keine Angebote oder Rechnungen.' (plain text, no EmptyState, also when filtered)
pages.phone: Cards; round + opens a glass menu with Neue Rechnung / Neues Angebot.
uxNotes: Title drift: nav says 'Rechnungen', page title says 'Angebote & Rechnungen'.
Kind switch is a hand-built chip nav instead of <Segments>.
Status filter offers 'Angenommen' but not 'Abgelehnt' for quotes.
No EmptyState for a first-time org; filtered and unfiltered empty use the same text.
No ExportMenu (accounting data, other money lists like cashbook have one).

redesign.job: See what is open or overdue and find any quote/invoice fast; start a new one.
redesign.phone: Top bar: Rechnungen, ⋯ (gear, export). Toolbar: search full width, then one scrolling row: Status filter, contact chip (?contact=), kind Segments Alle · Rechnungen · Angebote · Storno. Cards: number (or 'Entwurf') + recipient, line 2 kind · date, status badge, amount. Round + opens Neue Rechnung / Neues Angebot.
redesign.desktop: <ListToolbar>: search · Status filter · contact chip · kind <Segments> on the right. Table: Dokument (number + recipient, muted kind), Datum, Fällig, Status badge, Betrag right-aligned.
moves: title 'Angebote & Rechnungen' → 'Rechnungen' (= sidebar, crumb; glossary: Rechnungen = Angebote + Rechnungen)
q SearchBox → <ListToolbar> search (unchanged)
kind hand-built chip nav → <Segments> on the right (Alle · Rechnungen · Angebote · Storno, same ?kind values)
status FilterMenu → toolbar (unchanged), options now also 'Abgelehnt' (declined)
new: ?contact=<id> filter (documents of one contact) with a removable chip; linked from the contact page
column Nummer + kind → first column: number (or 'Entwurf') · recipient, muted kind line
column Empfänger → in the first column
column Datum → unchanged
new column Fällig (invoices: due date; quotes: valid until) so overdue is visible
column Gesamtbetrag → last column, right-aligned, tabular-nums
column Status → badge with status variants (secondary draft, warning open, destructive overdue, success paid/accepted, outline cancelled/declined/issued)
primary Neue Rechnung + more Neues Angebot → unchanged (links to /invoices/new, ?kind=quote)
gear → header settings (unchanged)
new: ⋯ Export (xlsx/csv, entity documents, same filters)
empty text → <EmptyState> with 'Neue Rechnung' for a first-time org; filtered empty keeps a short text
Pager → unchanged

sweep.note: Phone cards cut the dates and the badge (third line too long): now one short line 'TT.MM. · status badge' via phone-only columns (table: false), table unchanged. ListToolbar, coloured badges, EmptyState, export were already in place.

pages.title: (none: spinner 'Rechnung wird angelegt …' / 'Angebot wird angelegt …')
pages.purpose: Transit page: creates a draft invoice or quote on open (client effect) and redirects to it.

urlState.meaning: contact id to prefill the recipient (e.g. from a contact page)

uxNotes: Every visit creates a draft immediately: backing out of the editor leaves an empty draft that must be deleted by hand (Entwurf löschen).
Unlike other /new pages it has no form and no NewPage header; the page is only a loading line.

redesign.job: Write a new invoice or quote without leaving a draft behind if you back out.
redesign.phone: Same editor as a draft (see /invoices/[id]): Empfänger, Positionen, Angaben, Texte; SaveBar 'Entwurf anlegen' always visible; 'Rechnung ausstellen' in the top bar ⋯ (form button).
redesign.desktop: NewPage-style header (crumbs Rechnungen › Neue Rechnung) + the editor at form width; primary 'Rechnung ausstellen' (confirm) in the header, SaveBar 'Entwurf anlegen' at the bottom.
moves: automatic createDocument on open (client effect) → removed: nothing is created on GET; the editor posts and the draft is created on 'Entwurf anlegen' or 'Ausstellen'
spinner 'Rechnung wird angelegt …' → removed (the form shows at once)
?kind=quote → kind of the new document (unchanged)
?contact=<id> → recipient prefilled from the contact (unchanged meaning)
redirect to /invoices/<id> → after saving (draft) or issuing

sweep.note: Same editor as a draft: the Empfänger card ran off the right edge on phones (grid items without min-width; fixed once in FormCard + RecordPicker), Texte (intro/outro/internal note) moved behind 'Mehr Angaben (optional)' (open when one is filled). One form, SaveBar 'Entwurf anlegen'.

pages.title: Rechnung | Angebot | Stornorechnung <number>
pages.purpose: Edit a draft (recipient, dates, positions, texts) and issue it; for issued documents view, mark paid/accepted/declined, convert, duplicate, cancel, print.

header.badge: status per kind (Entwurf / Offen / Bezahlt / Storniert / Versendet / Angenommen / Abgelehnt)
header.meta: link 'Storniert Rechnung <n> →' or 'Erstellt aus einem anderen Dokument' or 'Shop-Bestellung #<n>'

menu.label: Stornieren
menu.notes: sent/paid invoices not from a shop order; destructive, confirm invoices.confirmCancel

sections.title: Billing hint
sections.notes: Drafts when org billing data is incomplete: invoices.billingMissing + link 'Einstellungen' → /invoices/settings.

fields.name: tax_mode
fields.label: Kleinunternehmer (§ 19 UStG)
fields.notes: per document, also set in settings

sections.title: Positionen (draft editor)
sections.notes: Rows in client state; per row icon buttons Nach oben / Nach unten / Position entfernen (tooltips); 'Position hinzufügen'; totals Netto, zzgl. n % USt., Gesamtbetrag.

sections.title: Issued document
sections.notes: Non-draft (or no invoices.manage): DetailList Empfänger, Datum, Fällig am, Bezahlt am, Gesamtbetrag + numbered item list (title · qty unit, line total). Read-only users see a draft this way too.

actions.label: Speichern
actions.notes: outline button at the end of the editor, no SaveBar

actions.label: Als bezahlt markieren / Doch nicht bezahlt

pages.phone: Editor: item rows stack to a 2-column grid; recipient/details stack; Speichern + Ausstellen at the end of a long form (no sticky SaveBar).
uxNotes: Issuing (number assigned, document frozen by GoBD) has no confirm, while cancelling and deleting a draft do.
Draft editor has explicit 'Speichern' + 'Ausstellen' buttons at the bottom instead of <SaveBar>; leaving with unsaved changes is not guarded.
Contact picker is a NativeSelect of up to 1000 contacts instead of <ContactPicker> (server search) used in the shop's new order.
Money and quantity use Input inputMode=decimal instead of <TypedInput kind=money|number>; email is Input type=email.
'Einzelpreis netto' label is shown even for documents with prices_gross (shop invoices).
Page uses <Page> default (list) size for a record/form; the editor is not grouped into FormCards like other records.
No 'send by email' action for invoices/quotes; only print/PDF.
Status buttons (bezahlt, angenommen, abgelehnt) sit below the item list, not in the header, so on phones they are at the very bottom.
Crumb label 'Angebote & Rechnungen' differs from the nav label 'Rechnungen'.

redesign.job: Draft: fill in recipient + positions and issue it. Issued: see paid/open/overdue, amount and due date, and do the next step (mark paid, convert a quote).
redesign.phone: Draft: top bar crumb back to Rechnungen, ⋯ (Ausstellen, PDF preview, delete draft). Editor as one column: Empfänger (ContactPicker fills name/address/email), Positionen as cards (title, description, quantity + unit, price + VAT, line total, ✕), '+ Position', totals; Angaben (dates, Kleinunternehmer); Texte; SaveBar appears on change. Issued: badge + meta (recipient · amount), Stats (Betrag, Fällig/Gültig bis, Bezahlt am / offen seit), the next step as the round/ⓘ primary (Als bezahlt markieren / In Rechnung umwandeln), then Positionen, Empfänger, Verknüpft (shop order, payment, cash book entries, source/cancellation, contact).
redesign.desktop: Draft: header primary 'Rechnung ausstellen' (confirm, saves first), actions 'Vorschau', ⋯ (PDF download, delete). Editor in FormCards: Empfänger · Positionen (one grid row per position) · Angaben · Texte, SaveBar. Issued: RecordLayout — left Positionen with totals; right Empfänger (DetailList, contact link, mailto), Verknüpft; Stats under the header.
moves: crumb 'Angebote & Rechnungen' → 'Rechnungen' (→ /invoices?kind=<kind>)
badge → status variants (secondary Entwurf, warning Offen/Versendet, destructive Überfällig, success Bezahlt/Angenommen, outline Storniert/Abgelehnt/Ausgestellt); overdue invoices show 'Überfällig'
meta links (Storniert Rechnung n / Erstellt aus … / Shop-Bestellung #n) → 'Verknüpft' section (both directions); meta = recipient · amount
header action 'Vorschau / PDF' → header action (unchanged, outline)
⋯ 'PDF herunterladen' → ⋯ (unchanged)
⋯ 'Stornieren' → ⋯ destructive with confirm invoices.confirmCancel (unchanged)
⋯ 'Entwurf löschen' → ⋯ destructive with confirm (unchanged)
billing hint (org data missing) → kept above the editor with link to Einstellungen
Empfänger NativeSelect of 1000 contacts → <ContactPicker> (server search, quick create); picking fills name/address/email via a server action
recipient_name / recipient_address / recipient_email / recipient_vat_id → FormCard Empfänger (email as TypedInput email, address as Textarea)

title, issue_date, due_date / valid_until, service_from / service_to, Kleinunternehmer checkbox, datesHint → FormCard Angaben (unchanged fields; Kleinunternehmer stays per document because the API and old documents set it per document; default comes from settings)
intro / outro / notes textareas → FormCard Texte (Textarea component)

positions (title, description, quantity, unit, unit price, VAT, ↑ ↓ ✕, + Position, totals) → FormCard Positionen: inline rows (grid row from md, card on phones), price via <TypedInput kind=money>, quantity stays a decimal text input (German '1,5'), ✕ always visible, ↑/↓ kept as small icon buttons; label 'Einzelpreis' says brutto for prices_gross documents
'Speichern' outline button → <SaveBar> (unsaved-changes guard)
'Rechnung/Angebot ausstellen' button at the end → header primary (form button saving + issuing) with confirm invoices.confirmIssue + Hint (number + frozen)
issueHint text → the confirm's hint
issued DetailList (Empfänger, Datum, Fällig am, Bezahlt am, Gesamtbetrag) → Stats (Betrag, Fällig/Gültig bis, Bezahlt am) + Empfänger DetailList in the aside
issued numbered item list → Positionen section with net/VAT/total lines
'Als bezahlt markieren' → header primary with confirm invoices.confirmPaid (not for shop invoices)
'Doch nicht bezahlt' → ⋯ with confirm
'Angenommen' → header action (quotes in Versendet)
'Abgelehnt' → ⋯ with confirm
'In Rechnung umwandeln' → header primary for quotes (Versendet/Angenommen)
'Duplizieren' → ⋯
new: Verknüpft section — shop order, payment (via the shop order), cash book entries that paid it, source document / cancellation, contact (with 'Alle Rechnungen' → /invoices?contact=)
redesign.kept: uxNote 6 kept: sending invoices by email is a new feature (mail with PDF attachment, log), not part of this UX pass. Quantity stays a decimal text input (German '1,5'); a 'Mahnung' step does not exist yet.

sweep.note: Issued: frozen by law, so no inline editing (correct); next step (Als bezahlt markieren / In Rechnung umwandeln) now also a full-width button under the header on phones (it was only in the phone ⋯); meta no longer repeats the amount shown in Stats; unit labels fell back to the raw key 'invoices.units.Std.' for units that aren't keys (API/shop) – now shows the stored unit; links use the link utility. Draft: phone 'Rechnung ausstellen' button, overflow fixed, Texte behind Mehr Angaben.

pages.title: Einstellungen
pages.purpose: Org data printed on documents, tax status, bank details, defaults and texts, number ranges.

fields.name: invoice_intro / invoice_outro / quote_intro / quote_outro
fields.label: Rechnung: Text oben / unten, Angebot: Text oben / unten

sections.title: Nummernkreise
sections.notes: NumberRangeForm per kind (outside the main form) with own 'Speichern' button and live preview line; description invoices.numberHint.

uxNotes: This page is the only 'Einstellungen' entry for the whole Finanzen area, but it only holds invoice settings; the cash book and payments have none, and the IBAN here also feeds the shop's transfer payment.
Two save paths: SaveBar for the main form and separate 'Speichern' buttons per number range below it.
'Kleinunternehmer' can be set here and again per document in the editor checkbox.
IBAN/BIC labels are hard-coded strings, not from de.json.

redesign.job: Set up once what is printed on documents (name, address, tax, bank), defaults and number ranges.
redesign.phone: One form, sections stacked: Deine Angaben, Steuer, Bankverbindung, Vorgaben, Texte, Nummernkreise; one SaveBar.
redesign.desktop: Same at form width with FormCards; one SaveBar for everything (number ranges included).
moves: crumb 'Angebote & Rechnungen' → 'Rechnungen'
Deine Angaben fields (legal_name, street, postal_code, city, email, phone, website, representatives, register) → FormCard (unchanged); website as TypedInput url
Steuer (tax_mode Choice, tax_number, vat_id, hint) → FormCard (unchanged)
Bankverbindung (bank_name, IBAN, BIC) → FormCard; IBAN/BIC labels from de.json; hint that the shop's transfer payment uses this account
Vorgaben: short_invoices checkbox → unchanged; payment_days / quote_days → TypedInput number; template NativeSelect → <Choice> (3 → segments)
invoice/quote intro/outro textareas → own FormCard 'Texte' (Textarea)
Nummernkreise: NumberRangeForm per kind with own Speichern → number range fields inside the one form, saved with the SaveBar (saveBilling also saves both ranges); preview line kept
SaveBar → unchanged (now the only save)
redesign.kept: uxNote 0 kept: the cash book and payments have nothing to set up; the bank hint now says the shop uses this account. uxNote 2 kept: Kleinunternehmer per document stays (API and existing documents set it per document; the default comes from here).

sweep.note: Checked phone + desktop: grouped FormCards, TypedInput IBAN/BIC, number ranges, one SaveBar. No change needed (settings page stays a form).
